entry.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo (34 PTS) & Cade Cunningham (33 PTS) were GOING AT IT! 🔥 | November 14, 2026

media:group.media:title: Giannis Antetokounmpo (34 PTS) & Cade Cunningham (33 PTS) were GOING AT IT! 🔥 | November 14, 2026
media:group.media:description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo and Cade Cunningham put on an incredible SHOW as the Miami Heat defeated the Detroit Pistons 137-117! Giannis led the way with 34 points, 14 rebounds, 8 assists and 3 blocks, shooting an outstanding 13-of-17 from the field. Cade Cunningham also delivered a monster performance, finishing with 33 points, 5 rebounds and 8 assists while knocking down three three-pointers. Giannis made Miami history by recording his second game with 30+ points, 10+ rebounds, 5+ assists and 2+ blocks as a member of the Heat, tying LeBron James for the third-most such games in franchise history. Miami improved to 7-6, while Detroit fell to 8-4.

entry.title: Tyrese Proctor DOMINATED with His FIRST CAREER TRIPLE-DOUBLE | November 14, 2026

media:group.media:title: Tyrese Proctor DOMINATED with His FIRST CAREER TRIPLE-DOUBLE | November 14, 2026
media:group.media:description:
Tyrese Proctor put on a SHOW against the Dallas Mavericks, recording the first triple-double of his NBA career with 24 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists in the Cleveland Cavaliers’ 127-117 victory! The 22-year-old also set new career-highs in points (24) and assists (10), shooting 10-of-19 from the field while knocking down four three-pointers. With this historic performance, Proctor became the youngest Cavalier to record a triple-double since Darius Garland on January 12, 2022. The Cavaliers improved to 7-7 on the season, while the Mavericks fell to 7-6.
